item.title: Royals acquire right-handed pitcher Mitch Spence
item.description: The Kansas City Royals added pitching depth to their staff on Tuesday, acquiring right-handed pitcher Mitch Spence from the Oakland Athletics in exchange for right-hander A.J. Causey.

item.title: KBCA releases weekly rankings
item.description: The Kansas Basketball Coaches Association has released their latest rankings for the season. Several area teams are in the rankings this week.

item.title: Lady Demons Rally Past Great Bend; Red Demons Fall
item.description: The Dodge City High School basketball teams split a Western Athletic Conference road trip Tuesday night, as the Lady Demons pulled out a gritty 47-41 victory over Great Bend, while the Red Demons dropped a 91-66 decision.

item.title: Annual crime victims’ service awards open for nomination
item.description: TOPEKA – Five awards that recognize service to victims of crime are open for nomination, Kansas Attorney General Kris Kobach announced Monday.

item.title: CoBank Sharing Success Grant Application Period Now Open
item.description: Victory Electric encourages local nonprofit organizations to apply for a 2026 CoBank Sharing Success Grant for up to $30,000. Aimed at supporting local communities in the cooperative’s service area, the matching grant program is made possible by the Victory Electric Board of Trustees in partnership with CoBank, a national nonprofit cooperative bank.

item.title: Local library resources that might surprise you
item.description: Local libraries have a lot to offer. While the chance to borrow a great book free of charge is reason enough to visit a local library, libraries also offer a host of additional resources, some of which might surprise you.

item.title: Fresh from the Hen House

item.title: Gov. Kelly Signs Bipartisan Bill to Combat Crime, Bolster Public Safety
item.description: Gov. Laura Kelly has signed House Bill 2347 into law, a bipartisan measure designed to strengthen public safety in Kansas by increasing penalties for certain crimes and expanding legal tools to combat fraud, theft and human trafficking–related offenses.
